operating_income.source: FY2023/FY2024: us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss, accession 0001558370-24-016169. FY2025: not found (operating income null in filing data); not estimated

revenue_growth.source: Analyst assumption: revenue fell 15.6% in FY2024 and 11.7% in FY2025 (cyclical downturn); assume trough in FY2026 then recovery moderating toward long-run growth

ebit_margin.source: Analyst assumption: below FY2023 21.2% and FY2024 17.5% margins (computed from filed EBIT/revenue); FY2025 EBIT not found; mid-cycle level assumed

tax_rate.source: Analyst assumption: US federal statutory rate; Damodaran US Machinery effective rate 13.4% considered too low for a sustainable rate

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~1.0 (Damodaran US Machinery unlevered cash-corrected 0.894, D/E 0.147, 21% tax) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = cost of equity ~9.3%; after-tax cost of debt ~4.2% (Damodaran pre-tax 5.29%); weights 87/13 gives ~8.7%

terminal_growth.source: Analyst assumption: long-run nominal US GDP-like growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = debt_current 13,796 - cash 8,276 (accession 0001104659-25-122321). CAVEAT: tool flags total debt as likely incomplete (no long-term debt concept reported); true net debt likely much higher. Verify against the 10-K balance sheet.
